sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Think of classes as cookie cutters that shape your data.

• How to define a class with properties and behaviors
• The basic structure of a class definition
• How to turn classes into usable objects

sections.title: Core Concepts
Code Examples
Key Points
points: A class definition includes data fields (variables) and methods
Data fields store the state of the object; methods define its behavior
Objects are created from a class using: ClassName obj = new ClassName()
Access data fields and methods with the dot operator: obj.field, obj.method()
Each object has its own copy of instance data fields

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Classes are blueprints for creating objects. They contain fields (data) and methods (behavior) Practice defining simple classes to master the structure.

questions.question: What are the two main components of a class definition?
questions.explanation: A class definition contains data fields (instance variables that store the object's state) and methods (that define the object's behaviors and actions).

questions.question: What keyword is used to create a new object from a class?
questions.explanation: The 'new' keyword creates a new object (instance) of a class. For example: Circle c = new Circle(); creates a new Circle object.
